channel.title: Research & Academic Jobs | Urban Forest Park
channel.description: JRF, SRF, PhD and research associate jobs in environment and climate.

item.title: Consultant - AWARE Project
item.description: The Indian Institute of Public Health Gandhinagar seeks a consultant for the AWARE project, an international consortium focused on climate-change-related health threats. You will support research on diarrheal disease risks linked to climate variables through primary data collection and stakeholder engagement. The role requires field travel within Gujarat and coordination with government partners to develop effective public health adaptation strategies.
item.author: Indian Institute of Public Health Gandhinagar (Gandhinagar)

item.title: Senior Research Fellow
item.description: VIT Chennai invites applications for a Senior Research Fellow to work on a CSIR-ASPIRE project focused on AI-based model predictive control for hybrid wind-solar water pumping systems. The selected candidate will contribute to renewable energy integration research over a two-year period. There is an additional opportunity to pursue a PhD at VIT Chennai, subject to institutional admission policies and availability.
item.author: Vellore Institute of Technology (Vellore)

item.title: Project Associate-I - Forestry & Ecology (CSIR-TKDL)
item.description: CSIR-TKDL Unit, New Delhi invites candidates for two project-based Project Associate-I positions in Forestry & Ecology and Environmental Sciences. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 9:30 AM at the CSIR-TKDL Unit, New Delhi.
item.author: CSIR - Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) Unit (New Delhi)

item.title: Research Assistant (ICSSR Project)
item.description: Research Assistant under ICSSR funded project VIKSIT BHARAT@2047 at AUD. Salary Rs 37,000/month for 2 months (extendable).
item.author: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD) (New Delhi)

item.title: Research Associate & Field Investigator (ICSSR Project)
item.description: ICSSR-funded research project staff: Research Associate (Rs 47,000/month) and Field Investigator (Rs 20,000/month). Deadline 3/6 Nov 2026.
item.author: Rajiv Gandhi University (RGU) (Doimukh)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow – Landscape Ecology (Terai Ecoregion)
item.description: JRF for ANRF-funded project on land use/land cover changes in Terai-Duar Savanna and Grasslands Ecoregion. Salary Rs 37,000 + HRA. Deadline 11 Nov 2026.
item.author: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) (Roorkee)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow – Environmental Engineering
item.description: JRF in Environmental Engineering, School of Infrastructure. B.Tech + M.Tech required. Last date 6 Nov 2026.
item.author: Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar (IIT Bhubaneswar) (Bhubaneswar)

item.title: PhD / M.Tech (Research) Admissions - Centre for Climate Change and Disaster Management
item.description: C3DAR at IIT Mandi invites applications for PhD, M.Tech (Research), and dual-degree programmes for the January-July 2027 semester. Research areas include climate change, hydrology, water resources, environmental engineering, cryospheric studies, forest fire dynamics, and disaster management.
item.author: IIT Mandi - Centre for Climate Change and Disaster Management (C3DAR) (Mandi)

item.title: Lead Poisoning Surveillance Coordinator
item.description: The coordinator will be seconded to the Gujarat state health department in Gandhinagar to design and monitor blood lead surveillance programs. You will act as a primary liaison between government officials and Vital Strategies to strengthen health systems and reduce environmental exposure. This role involves extensive stakeholder engagement, technical training for field staff, and rigorous data quality oversight.
item.author: Vital Strategies (Gandhinagar)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow
item.description: The Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM) is hiring a Junior Research Fellow for a one-year project on a contractual basis. Candidates must attend a walk-in interview at the CWRDM headquarters in Kunnamangalam on 30.10.2026 at 10:00 AM with original certificates and proof of identity.
item.author: KSCSTE-Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (Kunnamangalam)

item.title: DPhil in Biology
item.description: The DPhil in Biology offers advanced training and the opportunity to conduct independent research within the Department of Biology. Students work under the guidance of academic supervisors on original projects involving fieldwork, laboratory experiments, or computational analysis. The program prepares graduates for careers in academia or research-focused sectors through a rigorous, supportive educational environment.
item.author: University of Oxford (Oxford)

item.title: PhD Research on Sustainable Rurban Food Systems
item.description: This doctoral research position at ATREE explores the transformation of urban food waste into livestock feed within rurban food systems. The successful candidate will investigate circular economy models to reduce waste and improve rural-urban resource efficiency. The role involves field-based data collection, stakeholder engagement across food supply chains, and rigorous academic analysis of sustainable food security pathways in the Indian context.
item.author: ATREE (Remote (India))

item.title: Research Associate - TGI
item.description: The Research Associate will support the TGI project in Maharashtra by conducting field-based data collection and socio-ecological analysis. You will work closely with the project team to document local biodiversity and community resource management practices. This role requires extensive travel within the state to engage with rural stakeholders and gather primary field data for ongoing conservation research.
item.author: ATREE (Maharashtra)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow
item.description: Gautam Buddha University invites applications for a Junior Research Fellow position to support ongoing scientific research projects. The selected candidate will work within the university laboratories to conduct experiments and data analysis under the guidance of principal investigators. This role offers an opportunity for early-career researchers to contribute to academic output while receiving a competitive monthly stipend.
item.author: Gautam Buddha University (Greater Noida)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
item.description: The Botanical Survey of India is recruiting additional candidates for Junior Research Fellow positions to support ongoing botanical exploration and taxonomic research. Selected fellows will work on documenting plant diversity and conducting field surveys across various regions of the country. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to national biodiversity conservation efforts under the guidance of senior scientists at BSI.
item.author: Botanical Survey of India (BSI) (Multiple Locations)

item.title: International Course on Heritage Conservation
item.description: The Wildlife Institute of India invites applications for its international training program focused on heritage conservation and management. Participants will engage with experts to explore the intersection of cultural heritage and natural resource management within Indian ecosystems. This course aims to equip professionals with the necessary skills to integrate heritage preservation into broader environmental conservation strategies across the country.
item.author: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) (Dehradun)

item.title: Biology PhD Programme
item.description: IISER Pune invites applications for its doctoral research programme in the Department of Biology. Candidates will engage in advanced research across diverse biological disciplines within a premier scientific environment. This position is designed for scholars aiming to contribute to fundamental research while working under the guidance of leading faculty members at the institute.
item.author: IISER Pune (Pune)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Tiger Ecology & Landscape Connectivity
item.description: The Wildlife Institute of India recruits a Junior Research Fellow for its tiger ecology programme covering corridor connectivity and prey dynamics in the Terai Arc Landscape. The fellow supports camera-trap based monitoring, occupancy analysis and spatial modelling for landscape-level conservation planning. The engagement is project-based, initially for one year and extendable as per funding norms.
item.author: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) (Dehradun)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Air Quality & Atmospheric Chemistry
item.description: A sponsored research project at IIT Delhi recruits a Junior Research Fellow to investigate urban air quality dynamics and secondary aerosol formation across the NCR. The fellow runs filter-based and real-time monitoring campaigns, curates datasets and applies statistical analysis to link emissions with pollution episodes. The role suits a candidate aiming for doctoral work in atmospheric chemistry.
item.author: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) (New Delhi)

item.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Avian Ecology & Habitat Assessment
item.description: SACON invites applications for a Junior Research Fellow to study avian communities and habitat quality across wetland and woodland landscapes in southern India. The fellow will run point-count and transect surveys, quantify habitat variables and analyse community responses to land-use change. The position is contractual for one year, renewable based on performance and project continuation.
item.author: Salim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History (SACON) (Coimbatore)

item.title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Environmental Sustainability & Climate Risk
item.description: IIT Kharagpur invites applications for a postdoctoral fellow to work on climate risk assessment and environmental sustainability modelling within an interdisciplinary research group. The fellow will lead a work package on vulnerability mapping and adaptation planning for eastern India. The position is contractual for one year with extension subject to performance and project funds.
item.author: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) (Kharagpur)

item.title: Research Associate - Biodiversity & Ecological Genomics
item.description: NCBS Bengaluru recruits a Research Associate for a project combining biodiversity monitoring with ecological genomics approaches. The associate will generate and analyse sequencing data from field-collected samples and maintain the project's biological and data archives. The appointment is contractual under an externally funded project.
item.author: National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) (Bengaluru)

item.title: PhD Position - Climate Dynamics & Earth System Modelling
item.description: The climate dynamics group at IISc Bengaluru invites doctoral applications to study monsoon variability and coupled ocean-atmosphere processes using Earth system models. The doctoral researcher will design model experiments, analyse large climate datasets and evaluate projections against observational records. The position includes coursework, computing support and supervision aligned with national climate assessment needs.
item.author: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) (Bengaluru)

item.title: Doctoral Fellowship - Climate Policy & Sustainable Development
item.description: TERI's doctoral programme invites fellows for research on climate policy instruments, carbon markets and sustainable development pathways. Fellows work within ongoing policy studies at the institute while registering for their PhD with TERI School of Advanced Studies. The programme blends quantitative policy analysis with field engagement across Indian states.
item.author: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) (New Delhi)
